$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for territory definitions. Edit this file (or append to it with `npm run ingest`), then run `npm run build:data`.
IMPORTANT: every record below is SAMPLE DATA invented to make the map render out of the box.
The ZIP assignments do NOT reflect real franchise boundaries. Replace them with your own
sourced data before treating any output as market intelligence. Records carry `source: "sample"`;
the app badges any territory with that source as UNVERIFIED.
brandId         required, must match an id in brands.json
owner           required, the operating entity / franchisee group — drives Color mode = Owner
zips            list of 5-digit ZIPs. Primary geometry driver.
counties        optional list of 5-digit county FIPS. Expanded to their ZIPs at build time.
cities          optional list of "City, ST". Expanded to their ZIPs at build time.
